firstSentence: Automate high-speed Invoice Reference Number (IRN) generation and cryptographic B2B QR code embedding in Tally ERP, achieving sub-200ms turnaround under GST Rule 48(4).
heroImageAlt: Automated IRN E-Invoice JSON Generation and QR Code Embedding Agents for Tally ERP in Bangalore
paragraphs: High-volume wholesale distributors, IT hardware vendors, and manufacturing suppliers in Bangalore face massive billing logjams when generating government e-invoices during peak dispatch hours. Manual generation of e-invoices through web portals or sluggish batch utilities causes gateway timeouts, invalid hash errors, and truck dispatch delays. Failure to print signed QR codes on B2B invoices invalidates tax credits and violates mandatory GST Rule 48(4) mandates.

Our sovereign e-invoicing architecture connects directly to local Tally ERP instances via private TCP sockets. When a billing operator saves a sales voucher, the agent extracts voucher metadata, validates customer GSTIN, and constructs a standardized JSON payload compliant with the GSTN e-Invoice Schema (INV-01). The payload is transmitted over secure mTLS to the Invoice Registration Portal (IRP).

The e-invoicing state machine captures the 64-character Invoice Reference Number (IRN), digital signature, and signed QR code from the IRP response in under 180 milliseconds. It automatically updates the Tally voucher with the IRN metadata and embeds the high-resolution vector QR code directly into the printable invoice format. In the event of IRP portal downtime, an automated failover switches to secondary IRP gateways (NIC, Clear, Cygnet) seamlessly.

Statutory compliance satisfies Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Rule 48(4) and e-Invoice system requirements. Operating with sub-180ms roundtrip latency, the system processes 4,200 invoices per hour without human intervention, ensuring 100% input tax credit (ITC) validity for corporate buyers.

faqs.question: What happens if the primary NIC e-invoice portal experiences downtime?
faqs.answer: The engine automatically reroutes the payload to alternative authorized IRP portals in under 500ms, ensuring uninterrupted billing during critical month-end dispatch windows.

faqs.question: Does the system print QR codes that roadside GST inspection officers can scan offline?
faqs.answer: Yes. The embedded vector QR code contains the full cryptographic signature and essential invoice details readable by government handheld inspection scanners without internet.

faqs.question: Can this agent handle credit notes, debit notes, and export invoices?
faqs.answer: Yes. The platform supports all statutory document categories defined under GST INV-01, including B2B invoices, export invoices, and credit/debit adjustments.
